::: {.portfolio-section #about}

## Where Biology Meets Data

I'm a clinical genomics professional and M.S. Bioinformatics student building toward a career in bioinformatics and computational biology.

At GeneDx, I work with high-throughput genetic testing workflows across whole genome sequencing, whole exome sequencing, microarray, mitochondrial, repeat expansion, and reanalysis cases. This experience has given me a strong appreciation for data quality, reproducibility, and careful interpretation in clinical genomics.

Alongside my work, I'm developing computational skills through Python-based genomics projects, bioinformatics coursework, collaborative technical programs, and biological data visualization. I'm especially interested in genomic data analysis, scientific computing, and computational approaches that connect biological questions with reproducible analysis.

:::

### Rule-Based Gene Annotation Pipeline

Developed a Python-based bioinformatics pipeline that integrates BLAST, HMMER, and TMHMM outputs through a rule-based decision hierarchy to assign functional annotations to unknown genomic sequences.

::: {.portfolio-section #conservation}

## Conservation & Community Science

My interest in biological data extends beyond human genomics. I've participated in wildlife monitoring, ecological surveys, habitat restoration, and community-science projects across Southern California.

My experience has included reviewing wildlife camera footage, supporting bird and bat surveys, conducting vegetation monitoring, using GPS in field activities, monitoring invasive species, and contributing to wetland and habitat restoration.

I'm particularly interested in the intersection of **conservation, biodiversity data, and computational biology**, including how structured ecological observations can be transformed into reproducible analyses and visualizations.

:::
